## Names

<a id="title_logo_row5"></a>
### [`title_logo_row5`](../../../src/banners.asm#L8) `$49BD-$49E4`

*data*

Title screen logo: four rows of 40 character codes that show_title_screen (title_copy_logo_rows) writes OR $80 (characters $80-$FF of the logo charset title_logo_chars) to screen row 5 ($8CC8, BRUCE LEE top half), row 6 ($8CF0, BRUCE LEE bottom half), row 2 ($8C50, DATASOFT PRESENTS) and row 9 ($8D68, BY RON J FORTIER).

- **Read by:** [`show_title_screen`](title_demo_start.md#show_title_screen) [`$0630`](../../../src/title_demo_start.asm#L160) (+38), [`show_title_screen`](title_demo_start.md#show_title_screen) [`$0630`](../../../src/title_demo_start.asm#L160) (+39)

<a id="player_banner_top"></a>
### [`player_banner_top`](../../../src/banners.asm#L36) `$4A5D-$4A6C`

*data*

Big "PLAYER n" text, 16 character codes for the top row and 16 for the bottom row, written OR $80. Shown by show_player_screen (rows 7-8, column 12) at the start of a turn and by game_over (rows 5-6, column 12). Bytes 14-15 of each row hold the digit: both copy it there from player_banner_digit_top/bottom with index current_player*2 (game_over copies only byte 14; its loop ends after one pass).

- **Read by:** [`show_player_screen`](title_player_screens.md#show_player_screen) [`$0EED`](../../../src/title_player_screens.asm#L109) (+14), [`show_player_screen`](title_player_screens.md#show_player_screen) [`$0EED`](../../../src/title_player_screens.asm#L109) (+15), [`game_over`](lose_fall_game_over.md#game_over) [`$191A`](../../../src/lose_fall_game_over.asm#L154) (+14), [`game_over`](lose_fall_game_over.md#game_over) [`$191A`](../../../src/lose_fall_game_over.asm#L154) (+15)
- **Written by:** [`show_player_screen`](title_player_screens.md#show_player_screen) [`$0EDC`](../../../src/title_player_screens.asm#L99) (+14), [`show_player_screen`](title_player_screens.md#show_player_screen) [`$0EDC`](../../../src/title_player_screens.asm#L99) (+15), [`game_over`](lose_fall_game_over.md#game_over) [`$190C`](../../../src/lose_fall_game_over.asm#L146) (+14)
